name: sound2song
description: Paste a YouTube URL and identify the songs in it (MERN + Python audio service)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,audio -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:audio"
scripts.dev:audio: nodemon --watch audio-service/app --watch audio-service/.env --ext py,env --signal SIGTERM --exec "audio-service\.venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir audio-service --port 8000"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
